digest.component_or_area: rebar metrics command and agent-lifecycle instrumentation
propositions: Agent-driven development loop lacks aggregation layer and durable trend visibility; no means to query how metrics move over time or whether gates provide value

Three tier-C blindspots leave no structural trace in event store: env/integration-diagnosis intervals, bug provenance (which prior change caused this), and bug outcome classification (regression vs plan-defect vs flaky)
Passive instrumentation must close blindspots via trustworthy signals (gate error handlers, git blame) rather than agent self-report, using existing event surfaces and new `caused_by` link relation
Bug-close workflow currently discards free-text reason; must replace (not supplement) it with bounded `--class` enum persisted on STATUS event, keeping required-argument count flat at 1

Auto-derived `caused_by` links from blame operate best-effort and non-authoritative; when blame cannot resolve unambiguously or bug spans multiple files, auto-derivation is skipped and explicit `--caused-by` override always wins

Snapshot series must be git-tracked at `.rebar/metrics-snapshots.ndjson` not under reports/ (which is gitignored), and all backfilled values require labeling with `source=backfill_classified` and `confidence=classified` to prevent authoritative aggregation
